question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)={x}_{1}(t)+3 \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=-{x}_{1}(t)+3{x}_{2}(t),\end{aligned}\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the initial value problem above. By applying the Laplace transform $L$ to both sides of each equation in our system, we get a system with variables ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$ In terms of the parameter $s,$ the solution of the new system is

${X}_{1}(s)=\frac{3-2s}{s(s-1)},\,$
${X}_{2}(s)=$ {{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
First, we compute the Laplace transforms of both sides of each equation in our system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}L\{{x}_{1}^{′}(t)\}=L\{{x}_{1}(t)+3\} \\ L\{{x}_{2}^{′}(t)\}=L\{-{x}_{1}(t)+3{x}_{2}(t)\}\end{aligned}\,\,
$$

Using the derivative property of the Laplace transform, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}sL\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-{x}_{1}(0)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}+3L\{1\} \\ sL\{{x}_{2}(t)\}-{x}_{2}(0)=-L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}+3L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}\end{aligned}
$$

which can be simplified to the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)+2={X}_{1}(s)+\frac{3}{s} \\ s{X}_{2}(s)-1=-{X}_{1}(s)+3{X}_{2}(s)\end{aligned}
$$

where ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\},$ and we have used the fact that $L\{1\}=\frac{1}{s}.$

Now, solving the first equation for ${X}_{1}(s),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)+2 & ={X}_{1}(s)+\frac{3}{s} \\ (s-1){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{3}{s}-2 \\ (s-1){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{3-2s}{s} \\ {X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{3-2s}{s(s-1)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting this in the second equation and solving for ${X}_{2}(s),$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{2}(s)-1 & =-{X}_{1}(s)+3{X}_{2}(s) \\ (s-3){X}_{2}(s) & =1-{X}_{1}(s) \\ (s-3){X}_{2}(s) & =1-(\frac{3-2s}{s(s-1)}) \\ (s-3){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{s(s-1)-3+2s}{s(s-1)} \\ (s-3){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{{s}^{2}-s-3+2s}{s(s-1)} \\ (s-3){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{{s}^{2}+s-3}{s(s-1)} \\ {X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{{s}^{2}+s-3}{s(s-1)(s-3)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution of the new system  in terms of parameter $s$ is 

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=\frac{3-2s}{s(s-1)},\,{X}_{2}(s)=\frac{{s}^{2}+s-3}{s(s-1)(s-3)}.
$$
